plain_english: Senses cast off, having sat with absorption even once — the highest stands face to face with the yogi whose work is done.
sanskrit_cite: nirastakaraṇo yena samādhiḥ sevitaḥ sakṛt / paraḥ sākṣātkṛtas tena caritārthena yoginā

plain_english: Unbroken in the I-self, gathered by his own effort — may he wake, and stand in himself, till he shines as Sadāśiva.
sanskrit_cite: ahamātmany asambhinnaḥ saṃgṛhya svaprayatnataḥ / prabuddhaḥ syāt svaniṣṭhaḥ san yāvat sādāśivadyutiḥ

plain_english: His turning partless, all objects dropped, the knower who won the winning, aimed at waking alone, standing in himself — indeed he casts off his own sheath, the yogi.
sanskrit_cite: nirastasarvārthaniraṃśavṛttir jñānī sakṛt svātmani labdhalābhaḥ / samyaṅnibodhaikaparaḥ svaniṣṭhaḥ svakañcukaṃ hanta jahāti yogī

plain_english: Whose honest method is the word and the taste, unbroken in self-awareness — he is fit to make teaching, and to wake pupils rightly.
sanskrit_cite: vāganubhavasadyuktir yasyāsti nirantaraṃ svasaṃvittau / tasyopadeśakaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ śiṣyeṣu bodhanaṃ samyak

plain_english: From wanting nothing, from self-waking, from dropping hope and pride, from cutting the road of real-and-unreal — no taking of a body again.
sanskrit_cite: nairvāsanyāt svasaṃbodhāt tyāgād āśābhimānayoḥ / sadasatpadavicchedān na punar vigrahagrahaḥ

plain_english: Inner sense at peace, fancies thinned, delighting in the gain of his own form, drunk on the nectar of tasting himself — he goes to freedom, his work done.
sanskrit_cite: āśvastāntaḥkaraṇaḥ kṣīṇavikalpaḥ svarūpalābharataḥ / svānubhavāmṛtatṛptaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti caritārthaḥ

plain_english: So, for reaching the goal — stainless, lighting consciousness, true, mother of freedom's rise — I have told the perfection of self-waking.
sanskrit_cite: ittham upeyaprāptau vigatamalā citprakāśikā satyā / kaivalyabhūtijananī svabodhasiddhir mayā gaditā

plain_english: This teaching can make even one who never won enough, and free him from doubt's fault — with such doubtless teaching, what business has the much-chanting scholar?
sanskrit_cite: yenopadeśena nalabdhalābho bhavaty alaṃ saṃśayadoṣamuktaḥ / tenopadeśena nasaṃśayena kiṃ nāma kuryād bahuśāstrapāṭhī

plain_english: All-blessing maker, wildfire to tangled deeds, shower of your own station, free of every notion, temple of all joy — to cut suffering's root I bow to the unmatchably lovely Śiva, taught from the guru's mouth.
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣakṛtamaṅgalaṃ vividhakarmadāvānalaṃ svarūpapadadarśakaṃ sakalakalpanāvarjitam / samastasukhamandiraṃ vividhaduḥkhamūlacchide namāmy asamasundaraṃ gurumukhopadiṣṭaṃ śivam
